title: NIPER Raebareli and AstraZeneca India Partner to Strengthen Clinical Research Capabilities Across 25 Emerging Geographies
subtitle: Department of Pharmaceuticals Supports NIPER Raebareli–AstraZeneca Collaboration to Advance India’s Clinical Trial Ecosystem Under Biopharma SHAKTI
body_text:
To strengthen India’s clinical research capabilities and expand the country’s participation in global clinical trials, National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER), Raebareli , and AstraZeneca India have partnered to extend clinical trial capabilities beyond the metros, building a trained workforce and inspection-ready sites in 25 emerging research geographies across India. The MoU was signed in the presence of Shri Manoj Joshi, Secretary, Department of Pharmaceuticals , Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilisers in New Delhi today. This collaboration furthers the vision of Biopharma SHAKTI , the Government of India’s flagship initiative to build a stronger biopharma ecosystem, including setting up 1,000 clinical trial sites across the country.
The collaboration will begin with adopting 25 clinical trial sites, assessing their capabilities, providing targeted training and mentoring, and strengthening documentation and support processes related to ethics, safety and trial feasibility. The Department of Pharmaceuticals, will provide direction and endorsement, aligning the initiative with national clinical research priorities. Building on this government-led framework, AstraZeneca India will contribute clinical development expertise to design and deliver the programme, engage India and global faculty, and support the participating sites through training, workshops, governance and site-readiness.
In his address, Shri Manoj Joshi , Secretary, Department of Pharmaceuticals, stated, “Our country has the talent and expertise to play a larger role in global clinical trials. Strengthening clinical trials capabilities beyond major metropolitan centres will help expand the pool of skilled professionals and research-ready sites across the country. This collaboration brings together government, academia and industry to strengthen clinical research capabilities in a structured manner and directly advances key objectives of Biopharma SHAKTI.”
Dr. Shubhini Saraf, Director NIPER Raebareli, highlighted that “The Centre of Excellence will provide a dedicated platform for structured training and certification in clinical research. By combining academic and industry expertise, NIPER Raebareli will help develop a skilled workforce and create a model that can be expanded to other geographies and therapeutic areas.”
Shri Praveen Rao Akkinepally, Country President and Managing Director of AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited, stated that “Clinical research is central to bringing innovative medicines to patients. Our collaboration with NIPER Raebareli, with Government support, aims to strengthen India’s clinical research capabilities, expand trial participation and build a sustainable, high-quality research ecosystem.”
The initiative is designed as a scalable national model, with the potential to expand to additional geographies and therapeutic areas beyond oncology following the proof-of-concept phase.
